title: An Adaptive Transformer-Based Model with Entropy-Driven Knowledge Distillation for Single-Channel EEG REM Sleep Detection
description: This software repository provides code and supporting materials for an entropy-driven adaptive knowledge distillation framework integrated with a lightweight Transformer for REM sleep detection from single-channel EEG signals. The release includes implementation components for EEG preprocessing, model training, adaptive temperature scaling, entropy-based distillation weighting, evaluation, and figure generation used in the related manuscript submitted to Scientific Reports.
notes: This release does not redistribute the original Sleep-EDF, ISRUC-Sleep, or MASS datasets. Users should obtain datasets from their original providers and follow the access conditions of each dataset.
